voice_015:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: Time to show my training results!

voice_015:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: No time to hesitate! Let's go!

voice_015:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: You won't have your way anymore!

voice_015:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: I've got to do my part too!

voice_015:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: There are things even I can do!

voice_015:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: The enemy's right in front of me!

voice_015:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: If that's how you want it...!

voice_015:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: If I can draw out Aquarion's power!

voice_015:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: I can feel everyone! I can do this!

voice_015:r_0121a166c715cdff.text: I'll defy fate and embrace today!

voice_015:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: My wings will soar beyond fate!

voice_015:r_80a0b2a84e05d81a.text: No past!\nFight for now and tomorrow!

voice_015:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: I'll turn these feelings into power!

voice_015:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: Zessica, lend me your power too!

voice_015:r_bf3244994760e535.text: If you lack nerve, give me the lead!

voice_015:r_aabfb21c9d069ce7.text: I'll show you I can do it too!

voice_015:r_8927e6fb681aa809.text: Roger! I won't let you down!

voice_015:r_a571eec59b258d11.text: All right! Let's do this, Andy!

voice_015:r_faae935cca0edc72.text: I'm fine, Andy! I can do this!

voice_015:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: Amata, let me hear your melody.

voice_015:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: I-I don't get it, but I'll try!

voice_015:r_36133ad73a73ef98.text: Now our sounds will play a new song!

voice_015:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: Amata! Their weak point is there!

voice_015:r_52dfc56b14b93551.text: All right! I'll aim right there!

voice_015:r_cf41e8828a90cbdb.text: Come on, Amata! Quit spacing out!

voice_015:r_f2d4255f1c2f7542.text: Yunoha! Unite your power with ours!

voice_015:r_5d08ad19e2da125b.text: I-I'm shy, but I'll do my best!

voice_015:r_a7246b52782a877e.text: Oh! Now I'm really getting fired up!

voice_015:r_d6bdd730f24f66eb.text: Amata! Show me how cool you can be!

voice_015:r_41997412868c48c4.text: I-I'll just give it all I've got!

voice_015:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: Amata Sora, I expect great things.

voice_015:r_065443f6ddfcf0d7.text: Whenever you are. Go, Amata Sora.

voice_015:r_847f82e7f3eef651.text: Go, Kagura! Lend me your power!

voice_015:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: Heh! This doesn't feel half bad!

voice_015:r_8fdf5910927c9591.text: You're coming too, Kagura! Let's go!

voice_015:r_93e25418a203cb8f.text: If this power can forge the future!

voice_015:r_adeb0a29274d3d9b.text: Amata! I've read the enemy's moves!

voice_015:r_620fedec67706d7d.text: Oh, look at you two showing off...

voice_015:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: Yeah! Let's go, both of you!

voice_015:r_46e86d000250e137.text: Don't decide that on your own!

voice_015:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: I'll use the ultimate duo's power!

voice_015:r_a007f9ab9cf048b3.text: Amata! Take Yunoha's power and mine!

voice_015:r_ddafde4b065ced49.text: For the future of the world!

voice_015:r_de1213040856c089.text: All right! We'll fight as one!

voice_015:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: I'll unite your powers with mine!

voice_015:r_d692f1d420460a47.text: A chance! Time to strike again!

voice_015:r_a5643cec86b18bd2.text: If we can land one more blow...!

voice_015:r_9cedad8237480563.text: I won't give Mikono to you!

voice_015:r_a03fabecba1508ca.text: I swear!\nI'll save Mikono from you!

voice_015:r_5391b24a71eb10ae.text: You won't lay one finger on\nMikono!

voice_015:r_a77f4913375098d2.text: Go back to your world, Abductor!

voice_015:r_dad38ee29af2df3a.text: I'll stop that unit and rescue MIX!

voice_015:r_3d32e86f8dc80909.text: Defeat that one, and the war ends!

voice_015:r_8ab47a28f99ef565.text: I'll sever the root of this evil!

voice_015:r_ca85f87cee5e31f7.text: Not Apollo or Polon!\nI'm Amata Sora!

voice_015:r_d89011fe3e5d082a.text: I can't match Spada's speed, but...!

voice_015:r_3c5b0c2ac812d5de.text: If I can slip past Spada's blade...!

voice_015:r_5b9e8897190892eb.text: Aquarion won't lose in raw power...!

voice_015:r_dd01a4c0d1b36a8d.text: They're small, but I can't relax...!

voice_015:r_20920ad2eb3542db.text: Their speed can fool me and beat me!

voice_015:r_0ab7914877fd48ed.text: I'll take them on with my wings!

voice_015:r_cb846feec748c2e3.text: Aerial foe? Then I'll use my wings!

voice_015:r_c958860b0676b1f5.text: A Gundam? I still won't lose!

voice_015:r_7847e0ed7dc9282d.text: It's so small, I can barely aim...!

voice_015:r_ad3d538f1e909184.text: No pilot means I can go all out!

voice_015:r_8c61c59a1c0aebbf.text: I won't lose to some machine!

voice_015:r_aba6a7662129d8ce.text: It's a monster...! I'll go all out!

voice_015:r_c8c59db85bf875e6.text: If words fail, we'll have to fight!

voice_015:r_7c796ba53bd7ea03.text: I must stop that one at all costs!

voice_015:r_fa944da4b6519006.text: No calamity will take our future!

voice_015:r_95d047bcc17fccc6.text: I won't lose to a future of despair!

voice_015:r_d0372a183d2007ad.text: Aliens won't do as they please here!

voice_015:r_217aa5e1d545b44d.text: Aim at Earth and you face me!

voice_015:r_5aeeb4917340c42d.text: Sink that ship and disrupt command!

voice_015:r_7d2617c809fead70.text: I won't let you have your way here!

voice_015:r_ceb935ccbf830724.text: My... our feelings will strike you!

voice_015:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: Our hopes beat fate, forge tomorrow!

voice_015:r_001cbec4d9a4283f.text: Our feelings and love will beat you!

voice_015:r_26e5efec03c03d78.text: We won't let you have your way!

voice_015:r_4e37f92e7d2fc62e.text: Time to pay you back, Mikage!

voice_015:r_45abf84f7757d6eb.text: If I can land a direct hit!

voice_015:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: If they're at range, I'll use this!

voice_015:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: If I draw them into close combat!

voice_015:r_e33693e5ba4665b0.text: Take this! And this! And thiiis!

voice_015:r_1d6d784036ae0bd7.text: Run all you want! This'll reach you!

voice_015:r_625664af02183c17.text: This is the legendary Mugen Attack!

voice_015:r_76f080a4881e8ab5.text: Amata! Turn my feelings into power!

voice_015:r_0e7466971bec4cc4.text: We'll fly as far as we can!

voice_015:r_087354f2db0a31e6.text: All right! Now it's our turn!

voice_015:r_d520c6d5298a848d.text: I won't just keep taking hits...!

voice_015:r_099e2458cabf796f.text: I've got to catch up fast!

voice_015:r_fd910d714be70870.text: If I don't fight, they'll get me!

voice_015:r_bece29562818acba.text: I'll take it from here! Fall back!

voice_015:r_a4a5a96f4bd58920.text: I can at least serve as your shield!

voice_015:r_cd06d0820d82524b.text: We'll take the attack for you!

voice_015:r_c94c6d04be583774.text: I'll protect everyone in my club!

voice_015:r_e54e2c99ef8297af.text: We'll be beaten down at this rate!

voice_015:r_98902fd3143c393e.text: Damn! I can't counter from here!

voice_015:r_ce140b5d8e6b7310.text: Good!\nThey can't keep up with us!

voice_015:r_0e0335789c5396d7.text: My special training is paying off!

voice_015:r_772c8bc40ab6cb61.text: I can do this if I stay calm!

voice_015:r_58dd2826a199ef51.text: No way\nwill your attack hit me!

voice_015:r_25493e978ce8ff16.text: You've got a good rhythm, Amata.

voice_015:r_7316666150e42960.text: Y-you think? I don't really know...

voice_015:r_c4f11aa93dc5b668.text: Nice, Amata! You've got sharp eyes!

voice_015:r_a6630215fefaf294.text: I don't want to frighten Yunoha.

voice_015:r_d8c669c70659e18a.text: An attack like that won't hit me!

voice_015:r_05ea490d2f522520.text: That was the optimal move, Amata.

voice_015:r_f5658c702d91db7a.text: It's all thanks to Jin's advice.

voice_015:r_686df329b50f195b.text: Well done! I respect you now, Amata!

voice_015:r_b708a1d959013dbf.text: All right! I dodged it perfectly!

voice_015:r_279da5f732aa8847.text: My backup plan came in handy!

voice_015:r_6f12cc8ed2732eb5.text: We've got a barrier, so we're fine!

voice_015:r_99e7a66c650b5892.text: Whoa! I built up too much momentum!

voice_015:r_2d7a9c06347582d9.text: Looks like our armor stopped it!

voice_015:r_bf953d64c3c7d9b7.text: But I know I dodged that...!?

voice_015:r_66236eb99b676e5b.text: That doesn't even count as damage!

voice_015:r_9639a2dbcd2f58ed.text: That won't stop me as I am now!

voice_015:r_aeea0893acb93d35.text: I won't yield to your attacks!

voice_015:r_b31568654e53487b.text: Is that all you've got, Kagura?

voice_015:r_09d377101a48d92a.text: Damn! I knew you'd try that!

voice_015:r_11517cc7b0494dbf.text: If you knew, then dodge it!

voice_015:r_2970a83693cdcc25.text: What's wrong, Amata? You got hit!

voice_015:r_be661448b85d0009.text: Sorry, Malloy! I let my guard down!

voice_015:r_8b18aa4cc69547df.text: Sorry, MIX! I'll do better next time

voice_015:r_192447448ebd7bb5.text: Sorry! I'll be careful next time!

voice_015:r_207b256d613bb896.text: Skip the report. Focus on the fight.

voice_015:r_a6fd676d8146501b.text: Amata, your reactions are too slow!

voice_015:r_94d35e5fa8e3a198.text: Looks like\nI fell for their feint!

voice_015:r_b686510e636673f3.text: What are you doing? Let me lead!

voice_015:r_59369bad143d4272.text: No need! I'm the Head right now!

voice_015:r_20cfb719db02fafd.text: This isn't enough to break me!

voice_015:r_570c1fdf72edb283.text: If the engine's intact, I can fight!

voice_015:r_60c94ea4eb7f7404.text: I'm fine!\nThat wasn't a fatal blow!

voice_015:r_727b2ee0277f9159.text: I won't lose... least of all to you!

voice_015:r_79e0d542fe12bcf7.text: I'm fine! Focus on the fight, Amata!

voice_015:r_b2dc77aa6dd77e69.text: A direct hit! They read our moves!

voice_015:r_0abd8b6c713ccdac.text: Damn! They attacked where I dodged!

voice_015:r_f4ff463b2fda1b86.text: Come on, Amata!\nI won't die yet!

voice_015:r_141415c1def5ab2d.text: I know! We'll turn this around!

voice_015:r_79b1abf5fc86483c.text: I've got to do something first...!

voice_015:r_d52bece55796f599.text: It's okay, Yunoha! I'll find a way!

voice_015:r_b02fca1590ac1210.text: Amata Sora! This is the real test!

voice_015:r_f0344d2fbaa9db77.text: Yes! I'll give it all I've got!

voice_015:r_3328eef766ff2c2c.text: By my math, more damage would...!

voice_015:r_a9e6ed99025a703b.text: Stay calm, Kagura! We'll rally now!

voice_015:r_b0d1459d6daeebbe.text: Whoa! Is this as far as we go!?

voice_015:r_cd4893b409472e97.text: I have to do something... Anything!

voice_015:r_5691cc71770ffdde.text: Even Aquarion can't take any more!

voice_015:r_964e07c5563a5508.text: No! I can't shake the enemy!

voice_015:r_2174bd0edc164171.text: No surrender!\nHope lives to the end!

voice_015:r_ad54419336b49578.text: Not yet! My wings aren't broken yet!

voice_015:r_02d24e5915bfa5b7.text: Sorry, Mikono!\nHold on a bit more!

voice_015:r_49734bdb3507acf7.text: Okay, Amata!\nI'll fight to the end!

voice_015:r_b8ccfd8b8ac323ac.text: Damn it! I refuse to give up!!

voice_015:r_c885ff2097749991.text: Right!\nI'm not ready for my grave!

voice_015:r_5a20988e743dc1d0.text: W-we'll be done for at this rate...!

voice_015:r_c5c491f8761152f0.text: Y-yes! I'm scared, but I'll try!

voice_015:r_15042263763f11bb.text: Eek! I still\nhave lots left to do!

voice_015:r_2e756557a1d92e8b.text: You bastard! You'll pay for that!

voice_015:r_aeb9079d86e2a924.text: I level every unit evenly in SRW.

voice_015:r_bc4658630f8e40a9.text: I lose sleep choosing team pairings!

voice_015:r_a29f58ecde5f7ddd.text: What am I supposed to do...!?

voice_015:r_a30c8238b5208470.text: Sorry, Zessica. Just Mikono and me.

voice_015:r_64bf1c63c7c1ebdd.text: Great work! Rest up till next time.

voice_015:r_f6d5042f671118fa.text: Big talk, Kagura! Greet them right!

voice_015:r_0be18539fac21ba4.text: I can do it too if I try!

voice_015:r_0843e264eaaf3782.text: Yes, I'll shout the true name here!

voice_015:r_d1efc63b4a1fc079.text: If we can break their stance...!
